title: Sripuram Tourism Guide
content: Sripuram or Thirumalaikodi is a pilgrimage and tourism destination near Vellore, Tamil Nadu. The main attraction is the Sri Lakshmi Narayani Golden Temple. The Vellore District administration states that the temple is about 10 km from Vellore and is set within a 100-acre landscaped area.

title: Sri Lakshmi Narayani Golden Temple
content: The Sri Lakshmi Narayani Golden Temple is the main attraction of Sripuram. It is dedicated to Sri Lakshmi Narayani and is known for extensive gold-covered temple artwork. The Vellore District administration records about 1,500 kg of gold used in the covering.

title: Sri Narayani Temple and Narayani Peedam
content: The Sri Narayani Temple and Narayani Peedam are part of the spiritual complex associated with Sripuram and form part of the pilgrimage experience around the Golden Temple.

title: Sri Subramanya Swami Temple at Sripuram
content: Sri Subramanya Swami Temple is a Murugan temple in the Thirumalaikodi and Sripuram area. It can be considered as an additional nearby religious stop for visitors.

title: Ariyur Sri Shiridi Saibaba Temple
content: Ariyur Sri Shiridi Saibaba Temple is a nearby religious destination in the Vellore area that can be included in a wider Sripuram itinerary.

title: Vellore Fort
content: Vellore Fort is a major historical attraction in Vellore. The fort complex includes the Jalakandeswarar Temple, a mosque, a church, museums and other structures.

title: Jalakandeswarar Temple
content: Jalakandeswarar Temple is a historic Shiva temple located inside Vellore Fort. The Vellore District administration notes its Vijayanagara-era architecture.

title: Government Museum Vellore
content: The Government Museum is located in the Vellore Fort area. It is useful for visitors interested in the history and heritage of the Vellore region.

title: Amirthi Zoological Park
content: Amirthi Zoological Park is a nature and wildlife attraction about 25 km south of Vellore. It is listed by the Vellore District administration among the tourist places of the region.

title: Sripuram Travel Information
content: Sripuram or Thirumalaikodi is in Vellore, Tamil Nadu. It is about 10 km from Vellore. The main attraction is the Sri Lakshmi Narayani Golden Temple. Katpadi Junction is the nearest major railway junction listed in the tourism guide.

title: Sripuram Pilgrimage Itinerary
content: A Sripuram itinerary can include the Sri Lakshmi Narayani Golden Temple as the main attraction, followed by the Sri Narayani Temple and Narayani Peedam and other nearby religious or heritage attractions such as Vellore Fort.

title: Kanipakam Tourism Guide
content: Kanipakam in Chittoor District, Andhra Pradesh is a well-known pilgrimage destination famous for the Sri Varasiddhi Vinayaka Swamy Temple. The temple is about 11 km from Chittoor and about 68 km from Tirupati.

title: Sri Varasiddhi Vinayaka Swamy Temple
content: Sri Varasiddhi Vinayaka Swamy Temple is the main attraction of Kanipakam. It is dedicated to Lord Ganesha and is known for the Swayambhu or self-manifested deity associated with a water-filled well.

title: Sri Varadaraja Swamy Temple Kanipakam
content: Sri Varadaraja Swamy Temple is a Vishnu temple located near the main Kanipakam temple. It is one of the notable temples in the Kanipakam area.

title: Sri Manikanteswara Swamy Temple Kanipakam
content: Sri Manikanteswara Swamy Temple is a Shiva temple in Kanipakam and is associated with Goddess Maragadambika. It is located close to the main temple.

title: Kanipakam Temple Pushkarini
content: Kanipakam Temple Pushkarini, also called Koneru, is the sacred temple water tank in front of the main temple complex and forms an important part of the pilgrimage setting.

title: Kanipakam Temple Arch
content: The Kanipakam Temple Arch is a prominent landmark on the Kanipakam-Tirupati road and serves as an entry landmark for visitors approaching the temple area.

title: Kanipakam Surroundings
content: Visitors to Kanipakam can explore nearby local religious sites and the surrounding countryside. For a longer Chittoor-area itinerary, additional destinations can be added separately.

title: Kanipakam Travel Information
content: Kanipakam is in Chittoor District, Andhra Pradesh. The nearest major town listed in the guide is Chittoor, about 11 km away. Tirupati is about 68 km away. Chittoor Railway Station is the nearest railway station and Tirupati Airport is the nearest airport listed.

title: Kanipakam Pilgrimage Itinerary
content: A Kanipakam pilgrimage itinerary can focus on Sri Varasiddhi Vinayaka Swamy Temple and can include Sri Varadaraja Swamy Temple, Sri Manikanteswara Swamy Temple and the Temple Pushkarini.

title: Kanipakam and Tirupati Travel Planning
content: Kanipakam is about 68 km from Tirupati according to the tourism guide. A combined Chittoor-area travel plan can include Kanipakam and other destinations, subject to the customer's travel schedule and vehicle availability.

title: Destination Recommendation - Sripuram
content: For customers interested in pilgrimage and heritage tourism, Sripuram near Vellore can be considered. Its main attraction is the Sri Lakshmi Narayani Golden Temple, with Vellore Fort and other nearby attractions available for a wider itinerary.

title: Destination Recommendation - Kanipakam
content: For customers interested in pilgrimage tourism in Andhra Pradesh, Kanipakam can be considered. The main attraction is Sri Varasiddhi Vinayaka Swamy Temple, with other nearby temples and pilgrimage sites available for an itinerary.

title: Sripuram Heritage Tourism
content: A heritage-focused Sripuram trip can include Vellore Fort, Jalakandeswarar Temple and the Government Museum along with the main Sripuram pilgrimage attractions.

title: Sripuram Nature Tourism
content: Visitors interested in nature and wildlife can consider Amirthi Zoological Park, which the Vellore District tourism information lists as a tourist place about 25 km south of Vellore.

title: Kanipakam Religious Tourism
content: A religious tourism itinerary in Kanipakam can include Sri Varasiddhi Vinayaka Swamy Temple, Sri Varadaraja Swamy Temple, Sri Manikanteswara Swamy Temple and the Temple Pushkarini.

title: Sripuram Nearest Railway Information
content: The Sripuram tourism guide lists Katpadi Junction as the nearest major railway junction for Sripuram or Thirumalaikodi.
